newsitem.title: USA: Ingram Micro IPO price range set.
newsitem.headline: Ingram Micro IPO price range set.

text.p: The estimated price range on Ingram Micro Inc's initial public offering of 20 million shares has been set at $14 to $16 per share, according to a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
The company had not specified a range when it first filed for the IPO.
The offering, lead managed by Morgan Stanley & Co, is tentatively scheduled to make its debut on the New York Stock Exchange during the week of September 30. The proposed stock symbol is "IM".
Ingram Micro, headquartered in Santa Ana, Calif., is a wholesale distributor of microcomputer products, with sales in 1995 of $8.6 billion.
